# Open WebUI Source Regression

This directory contains two unmodified snapshots of
`backend/open_webui/utils/middleware.py` from the public
`open-webui/open-webui` repository.

| Snapshot | Commit | Git blob | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `middleware_v0_8_2.py` | `7c7fe443289c3d0307ebbcf320fb1d895c3ee79b` | `7ab7537de2cae7d0c1806ab7b4665d530010ce3d` | `1ffbbfee1b1975cf7cd868899580e11dc39ffc303ee1e229c7f4260786a4256a` |
| `middleware_v0_8_3.py` | `b8112d72b95e480f946f0688bed29321b61e65af` | `ec7af7733bad4ddb558f57c20edac06cf879943e` | `07fad22b951d912c0b436a098a8def0317810e8283a8f88d0f4eb73f9833b5ed` |

The second blob is introduced by upstream commit
`f1053d94c7ef7b8b78682dd73586b65a84d202a1`, whose parent is
`10cfddccd7ae017c7e268820b755e4033e88943a`. It is the only middleware
change between the two release tags: 26 inserted lines and one deleted line.
The change retains the message `files` field and converts user image files
into `image_url` content parts.

Primary sources:

- https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/issues/21477
- https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/commit/f1053d94c7ef7b8b78682dd73586b65a84d202a1
- https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/releases/tag/v0.8.2
- https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/releases/tag/v0.8.3

`code/scripts/audit_open_webui_source_regression.py` verifies both file
hashes and Git blob IDs, extracts and executes the exact upstream
`load_messages_from_db`, `process_messages_with_output`, and fixed image
injection AST nodes, then applies the released caller-owned contract to the
emitted local bodies. This is a source-level regression, not a full Open WebUI
server deployment. It uses synthetic one-pixel images and makes no network,
provider, or model call.

The upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE`.
